scope: Independent source review and bounded offline regression of quote retry and unstarted-provider-case ordinary withdrawal guard; no live network, private runtime state or financial action.

commands.command: target/i08-toolchain/bin/node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2023 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --allowImportingTsExtensions --resolveJsonModule --lib ES2023,DOM --types node scripts/run_i10_devnet_vault.ts scripts/provider_acceptance_client.ts scripts/provider_acceptance_client.test.ts scripts/i10_devnet_provider_recovery.ts scripts/i10_devnet_provider_recovery.test.ts

review.quote_retry: Fixed verified quote parameters only, before proof/reservation/AUTH; bounded monotonic and wall elapsed deadline with per-call signal. Only transient HTTP/known transport failures retry. Invalid/expired/signature failure stops without financial mutation; no post-AUTH quote replacement.
review.unstarted_case: Exact pre-AUTH quote503 checkpoint, initial unsigned note state and deposit-only history, empty session history and no pending AUTH. Selected case reservation must be ABSENT because quote precedes reserve. Existing global reservations and arithmetic stay validated and unchanged. Settled-case reservation must remain present.
review.root_runner: Explicit mutually exclusive recovery flag, existing lifecycle files, campaign/manifest/pool/note/selection/provider-config join, guard before ordinary mutual-close/resume/final report; provider acceptance helper and fresh deposit skipped. Historical source pins preserved.
review.financial_authority: Guard is read-only local evidence only; existing WalletClient must still obtain verified permanent clearance and verify actual finalized Note/proof/receipts.

intermediate_note: Earlier unstarted test fixture assumed a selected reservation. Final guard/tests explicitly require absence; only corrected logs above count toward final pass.
